scope: Exploratory analysis of already preserved16 cases only. Not a new prospective performance calibration; no GUI/SDK/USB/sampling/new human trials or production edits.
boundary_rules: received_ns is a source-construction timestamp preceding actual enqueue; do not call it an exact enqueue timestamp. Queue pending and oldest-item data are independent locked witnesses.
Never substitute touched/published device sample time for a host publication timestamp. Determine raw release trigger through original synchronous processing plus full output/state verification.

Bound host processing/dispatch times by saved monotone common batch-completion witnesses; no interpolated timestamps. Keep filter lookahead,20-frame inflight uncertainty and missing/contradictory bounds.
Report source-input confirmation progression, pre-publication backlog, and downstream GUI interval bounds as temporal evidence, not CPU/GIL/Qt shares or exclusive function cost.
Native5s counters cover different work when backlog differs. Keep PID/TID lifetimes and clock uncertainty; no cycles-to-frequency inference.
All16 cases, old calibration failures and query caveat remain. No pooling to pass3%/1% gates or treating first cases as discardable warm-up.
